title: AE60007: Flight Mechanics
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Prerequisites: NonePerformance characteristics of aircraft, steady level
flight, take off, landing and climbing flight, coordinated turning, concept
and definition of stability; static stability in longitudinal, directional and
lateral flights; dynamic stability, stability derivatives, characteristics
equation, typical modes of longitudinal and directional motions; stability
criterion and stability diagrams, Analysis of unsteady flight, concepts of
trajectory optimization, automatic control and guidance.
